run.title: iPhone Duo: regular-width Dashboard (summary column + chart grid)

stages.label: Spec
stages.note: docs/design/duo-dashboard-grid-spec.md. Mockup option 'Dashboard: the whole carousel at once' (Recommended). Proceeding on the user's go for the Duo optimisations after seeing the mockup; weekly spend strip left out. Prereqs #76 (SDK 58) and #77 (side insets) merged.

stages.label: Implement
stages.note: Built per spec: src/domain/dashboardLayout.ts (+11 BDD scenarios), one shared renderChartBody for pager and grid, two-column tree at ≥600pt content width, pager contentOffset keeps chartPage across a fold. tsc 0, eslint 0, 198 suites / 4303 tests. eval PASS 56.1% once the coordinator unshallowed the clone (bde1aeb was missing).

stages.label: QA (r2: PASS-w/-concerns)
stages.note: Round 1 PASS-WITH-CONCERNS: 1 Major — carousel slides sized from the full window while the viewport is the inset-adjusted card (Duo cover: 418pt slide in 334pt), so paging mis-counted and contentOffset nudged the pager; fixed by feeding chartSlideLayout the inset-adjusted width, spec §4.1 amended. Round 2: Major closed by arithmetic for cover/Split View/plain iPhone; round→floor mutant now caught (601 row), DONUT_MAX cap pinned (1600 row). No open Major; remaining items device-only. 198 suites / 4305 tests.

stages.label: Review (r3: APPROVE-WITH-NITS)
stages.note: Three rounds. R1 REQUEST-CHANGES: Blocker — the card's 1pt border made the pager viewport slideWidth−2 and Fabric re-applies contentOffset, so the pager would twitch after every swipe on every iPhone. R2 REQUEST-CHANGES: the one-shot restore left page n mid-slide after a fold changed the pager width. R3 APPROVE-WITH-NITS: re-seat on the MEASURED viewport width traced through Fabric source for mount, fold (two renders), y-only layout, swipe and clamping; pinned values recomputed by hand. Nits applied: onMomentumScrollEnd divides by the event's layoutMeasurement.width; spec §4.1 names contentWidthFor.

stages.label: Verify
stages.note: Run by the coordinator: tsc 0, eslint 0, 198 suites / 4310 tests, eval PASS 56.1% (dev) no case regressed.

stages.label: Commit + push + PR
stages.note: 2f1bfa9 (Ship-Run trailer) + fa97b26/c02fa52 (device-found ref fix) on claude/duo-dashboard-grid, pushed. PR #78: https://github.com/TSSQ/ProjectXavier/pull/78, subscribed.

stages.label: Device Hub ✅ · Build on Mac
stages.note: Device Hub round 2 on 1ae5b71: pass — fold from pages 2/3/4 lands on the same page with title, dots and pager agreeing in every captured frame. Merging #78. TestFlight Beta needs the Mac (/build after re-applying the Release target's manual signing).

history.title: Query polish + capability tutorial
history.note: 7 commits → TestFlight build 59 (delivery 2e0f0ff0, bump 4eb6555). Comparison charts (a 2-period comparison had rendered as a single stat); model-tier query grading with the first cross-engine numbers; a MEASURED prompt fix (the eval caught models declining on explicit years because we never told them the app corrects the period — 3 runs/engine: gpt-4o-mini 34→35/36, haiku 29→33/36, no new mismatches); capability tutorial (carousel 4→6) + a persistent 'What can I ask?' sheet whose every advertised example is TESTED to route as claimed, + the missing 'provider bills you directly' disclosure; 'Ask Xavier' placeholder; 'Copy' label; long-press Copy on the Transactions tab via one shared tested helper. 1255 tests, eval:intent 191/191, eval:query 100%.

history.title: Query eval corpus (tool + period grading) — no longer deferred
history.note: USER challenged the 'deferred' framing and was right: the intent gate was eval-driven but NOTHING graded tool/param selection — where every recent device bug lived. Now tests/query-corpus.jsonl (59 rows, each citing its device build) + npm run eval:query grades tool routing, period and filters deterministically at a 100% bar (no keys, no cost), with the corpus-first rule extended to floor routing + period extraction and a key-gated --engine= seam for later model-tier grading. It caught 2 live floor bugs on its first run (bare 'earn' unrecognized; trend questions confidently mis-routed to a single total) — both fixed, rows relabeled to ideal. Shipped with the period fix as build 58 (af45804 + 9fe0860, bump c042739, delivery 1f98f9b2). 1218 tests, eval:query 100%, eval:intent 191/191.

history.title: Ask-Xavier deterministic period extraction (device-found)
history.note: Committed 9fe0860 (1158 tests). 'how much income for year 2026' answered with THIS MONTH — root cause was a doctrine violation: no deterministic period extraction existed, so the model's token ran as-is and an explicit year was inexpressible → silent this_month. resolvePeriodFromText now reads relative phrases + explicit years + months from the user's words and OVERRIDES the model at all 3 tiers; PeriodSpec widened internally while the model-facing enum stays closed. 2 QA rounds: the first override collapsed multi-round COMPARISONS (regression from the coordinator's own spec) → now applies only when exactly ONE period is named; floor net_worth ignored the period entirely. Unmodelled shapes (Q1, 'since 2020') return null rather than a silently wider range.

history.title: Ask-Xavier BYOK caption unit fix (device-found)
history.note: Device (build 56): a BYOK query caption read '5,000' while the card showed SGD 50.00 — money is stored in minor units and the model was handed the raw result. Fixed + shipped as build 57 (feature a645781, bump 6e0a8da, delivery 9443fb83): formatAmountsForModel() gives the model display-formatted, currency-decimals-aware amounts (JPY/KRW 0-dec) in the tool_result content only; the card's raw result is untouched (wire regression proves it). FM/floor deterministic caption never restated a figure, so unaffected. Contained read-only fix, coordinator-verified (14 dedicated tests), 1114 tests. Awaiting device re-confirm.

history.title: Ask-Xavier query fixes (device-found)
history.note: Build-55 device testing surfaced real-model bugs the clean tests missed (all read-only). Fixed + shipped as TestFlight build 56 (feature e7ff471, bump 53cc4cf, delivery bf42dc5a): sentinel filter names ('none') no longer treated as real (match real entity first — a user's real 'None'/'All' entity still filters); captions built from RESOLVED filters ('Total spending, this month' not 'Spending on none, none, none'); 'where did my money go' recognized as a query → category donut (was falling to expense → a $12.50 hallucinated card); a leading 'where' never a command. 2 QA rounds caught a sentinel-name collision + a 'go' over-widen, both closed. intent-corpus grew to 191 (100% bar). 1100 tests. Awaiting device re-confirm.

history.title: Ask-Xavier queries (tool belt + charts) + eval-driven intent gate
history.note: Full stage-gated ship on claude/phase2-byok (feature 4d92ca3, bump 26d406c) → TestFlight build 55 (delivery bba9410e), metrics ON, supersedes 54. Read-only 7-tool query belt over balances.ts, rendered by the existing chart components; BYOK bounded tool loop (composition) + FM single-shot selection + floor. Model PLANS, deterministic code COMPUTES, an answer counts only if a tool ran. Workstream A: intent gate now EVAL-DRIVEN — 180-case corpus + npm run eval:intent at a 100% bar + corpus-first rule; rebalance-by-name rebuilt structurally. Most-gated feature yet (5 passes): QA caught 2 blockers (query gate swallowing expenses; BYOK loop OOM/crash) + 4 majors across 2 rounds; reviewer APPROVE-WITH-NITS confirmed read-only + loop-safety + zod + deterministic numbers structurally. implement r1→r3, verify 1061/1061 + eval:intent 180/180. Awaiting device confirm.

history.title: Chat account UPDATE + DELETE (option C + B primitives)
history.note: Full stage-gated ship on claude/phase2-byok (feature ea0958c, bump e7c15ac) → TestFlight build 54 (delivery d1821ffd), metrics ON, supersedes build 53; also carries the confused-face fix (c4a129b). Chat edits accounts (rename/retype/rebalance, deterministic findAccountMatch + write-guard) + recognizes delete → screen handoff (never executes); screen-only deleteAccountCascade forces a backup before an atomic tx deleting accountId-OR-transferAccountId rows + recurring rules + the account, full rollback, chat structurally can't reach it. The most-gated feature yet: QA caught a balance-corruption blocker (chat rename zeroing balance); reviewer caught the headline delete not resolving + a dead-end iCloud error — all fixed, none data-destructive. implement r1→r4, QA PASS-WITH-CONCERNS, review APPROVE-WITH-NITS, verify 795/795. Awaiting device confirm.

history.title: Chat-driven account creation (NL) — FM + BYOK
history.note: Full stage-gated ship on claude/phase2-byok (feature 1ba1abb, bump 18b1ef2) → TestFlight build 53 (delivery 2b23aec8), metrics ON, supersedes BYOK build 52. NL account creation across FM + BYOK OpenAI/Anthropic via a deterministic intent gate + one ParseContract abstraction (expense path byte-preserved); numbers deterministic; zod-validated; editable confirm card. The gate survived TWO independent false-positive catches (QA: transfer/possessive shapes; reviewer: attributive nouns like 'credit card payment') — both closed structurally + regression-locked in a 57-case suite. implement r1→r5, QA PASS-WITH-CONCERNS, review APPROVE-WITH-NITS, verify 701/701. Eval deferred (spec §10). Awaiting device confirm.
